results: 1. levodopa trial: DRAMATIC improvement within FOUR DAYS, sustained, with no treatment-related fluctuations
2. dystonia gene panel: GCH1-related dopa-responsive dystonia
3. DAT-SPECT: normal striatal uptake - distinguishes it from juvenile parkinsonism
dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Dopa-responsive dystonia (Segawa disease) due to GCH1 gene mutation
1. Other genetic causes of dopa-responsive dystonia (e.g., tyrosine hydroxylase or sepiapterin reductase deficiency)
2. Juvenile-onset parkinsonism (e.g., Parkin or PINK1 mutations) - though largely excluded by the normal DAT-SPECT
3. Early-onset isolated dystonia (e.g., DYT1 or other dystonias) - though typically less dramatically responsive to levodopa
dx: Dopa-responsive dystonia (Segawa disease) due to GCH1 gene mutation
